$comment: Files under `files` are exempt from the claude-md-length check up to their recorded word count (plus a 10% growth buffer). Each entry is {"words": N, "reason": "…"}: the reason is mandatory and says why this doc gets to be long, or starts with `TODO: ` when it should be trimmed and the reason says what moves to the sibling DETAILS.md. The push-tier CLAUDE.md is auto-injected into agent context, so it has a ~600-word budget; the pull-tier DETAILS.md is unlimited and not checked. The check shrink-wraps the numbers on local runs, so a reason is the only part written by hand. See `.claude/rules/file-length-allowlist.md`.
